name: Civil Rights Movement Timeline
description:
Create a 2-page visual timeline of the Civil Rights Movement in ActivInspire.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart with exactly 2 pages.
2. Page 1 (Title Page): Add the title 'Civil Rights Movement Timeline' and the subtitle '1954-1968'.
3. Page 2 (Timeline Page): 
   - Draw a horizontal line across the page to serve as the timeline axis.
   - Add at least 5 shape markers (circles or rectangles) along the line.
   - Add text labels for these 5 events next to the markers: 
     * Brown v. Board of Education (1954)
     * Montgomery Bus Boycott (1955)
     * March on Washington (1963)
     * Civil Rights Act (1964)
     * Voting Rights Act (1965)
4. Save the flipchart as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/civil_rights_timeline.flipchart'.
